description: Check a linked wallet's stablecoin balances and remaining agent spending allowance. Works with no arguments once this connector is authorized via OAuth.

api_key.description: AbaPay MCP API key (starts with aba_mcp_). NOT needed when the connector is authorized via OAuth — omit it entirely in that case; only supply it if this server asked you to authenticate and OAuth is unavailable.

chain.description: Defaults to the chain approved when the key was created.
